reviewer: Independent quality agent; no external independent human rating
basis: Frozen original MIT source facts plus source caption excerpts; summary and points assessed together semantically, not by matching keywords.
overall: Application JSON/count contract succeeded, but quality goal failed: relevant content disappears already in second section, before merge. Smaller final catch-all is not an improvement when important tail consequence is lost.

facts.note: Day two Chinese instruction and day-one preparation/syllabus/expectations retained.
Comprehensible classroom language and alignment of preparation with exercises retained, spread across three points.
Fixed classroom wording and repeat-once formulations retained.
First forty-five minutes Chinese, last five minutes/after-class/email English questions retained.

samples.organization_note: Same preparation theme is fragmented; mismatch consequence is a distinct relevant condition, not a pure duplicate.

facts.note: Daily grading and persistent effort teaching rationale retained, but expected competence is worded strongly.
Written feedback on language/culture and next improvement retained; usually-after-class retained.
Engrade/private comments/account retained; explicit ability to record grades omitted.
Performance-dependent pronunciation/compliments/course-material feedback retained, but cultural contrast loses speaker attribution.

accuracy_issues.note: Chinese humility versus American thanks stated as general culture rather than the instructor's illustrative view.
If sustained effort then can show skill reads as a guarantee; source frames this as instructor belief/expectation.

samples.observed_improvement: Usually-after-class qualifier is preserved in point 2, unlike old bounded output.

facts.note: Declarative versus imperative, steps, control flow and stopping condition retained; tolerances introduced as examples.
Stored changeable instruction sequences and control-flow changes retained.
Syntax/static semantics/intended meaning retained, but crash/failure-to-stop behavior absent.
Typed scalar/structured objects, constrained operations and expressions evaluating to values retained.
Summary retains generic name binding, but specific radius rebinding and already-calculated area staying unchanged are absent.

samples.tail_loss_stage: Second section response ordinal 8; merge ordinal 9 cannot recover omitted source fact from notes.

accuracy_issues.note: Important final scalar assignment example absent from second section and final result.
Result storage is called memory next to hundreds-of-GB storage. Do not infer this validates exact memory/storage distinction.

samples.organization_note: Last point still packs object types, conversions, output and many operators, and exceeds 240 soft-target characters. Less text with lost essential tail is not successful compression.

limitations: One inference per sample/profile from two MIT courses; review is an agent assessment and does not establish complete claim precision or statistical reliability.
